[P1] Release the checkpoint queue wait when the deadline passes

If a checkpoint request is still pending when this fires, `setTerminating()` only sets a flag, and the wrapper awaits `waitForQueueCompletion()` before checking the termination reason. The new `processQueue()` clearing branch cannot run until that request finishes. Consequently, a stalled checkpoint keeps the invocation pending beyond its deadline, preventing `InvocationDeadlineError` and cleanup. Abandon unsent work and release the wrapper's queue wait at termination without resuming operation callers. The held-request regression should assert the deadline error before calling `release()`; currently it releases the request first and misses this remaining failure.
